reason: Authoritative ESLyric contract: searcher-script API (getConfig/getLyrics, meta fields incl. rawPath, man/lyric object, request()), install paths under eslyric-data, LRC format rules, pitfalls (match threshold, no fs/settings UI, restart pickup). The lyrics half of the design codes directly against this.

Regression contract that must remain untouched (PRD S1): snapshot/immutable-context convention reused by the cover fetch, identity normalization reused for the cover-cache key, and the Release|x64 build/package/SHA-256 verification baseline.
Conventions for the new user-visible/console strings (Localization.h, wchar_t vs u8 literals, /utf-8 vcxproj requirement, no translation of API names/server messages).
